description: This file defines the ThemeAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing theme configurations within the OrangeHRM application. Its functions include fetching, updating, and resetting theme settings, involving complex validation rules and handling of media attachments.

classes.name: ThemeAPI
classes.description: API class handling theme-related endpoints for fetching, updating, and resetting themes within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches the current theme details, returning a partial theme object.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the theme configuration, including variables and media assets, after validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Resets/deletes the custom theme, reverting to defaults.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching theme details.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating theme configuration.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for resetting the theme.

methods.name: getAttachmentParamRule
methods.description: Helper method to generate validation rule for attachment parameters with aspect ratio enforce.
